title: Grayton Beach "Sandy Paws" 310 Morgan's Trail
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private beach access at Sanctuary by the Sea- Tennis/Pickleball- 2 community Pools (One pool is heated only between the dates of 11/15-12/2, 12/16-1/6, and March spring break 3/4-5/20)- Clubhouse amenities - Gas fire pit- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover serenity at Sandy Paws, a stunning coastal retreat in Grayton Beach that sleeps up to 9 guests. With 4 spacious bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, this beautifully designed home has everything for a perfect getaway, including a private boardwalk that’s only a short 10-minute stroll away. Enjoy community amenities like tennis and pickleball courts, 2 sparkling pools, and a clubhouse. Spend evenings gathered around the cozy gas fire table, where cherished memories are made and relaxation comes effortlessly.A charming 2-story white façade, complemented by an inviting front porch, sets the tone for Florida elegance. French doors open into a bright and welcoming living area, adorned in white shiplap walls accenting the serene coastal ambiance. Sink into the spacious sectional couch facing a wall-mounted TV for a quick post-beach nap or family movie nights filled with laughter and popcorn. The open layout seamlessly connects to a modern galley kitchen, complete with sleek countertops, high-end appliances, and a large island with seating for 4. Nearby, a sunlit dining nook seats 6 for sit-down meals together. After a day of beachcombing, the first-floor guest bedroom offers a serene retreat with a king bed, private bathroom featuring a soaking tub and separate shower, and French-door balcony access. Step outside to the charming patio and fire up the propane grill for a delightful alfresco meal. Dine under the pergola at the outdoor table as coastal breezes cool the air, then warm up by the fire table rocking in the cozy chairs—a perfect Emerald Coast evening! For convenience, there’s an outdoor shower to rinse off sandy feet and a first-floor laundry room to keep beach gear fresh.Upstairs, the second floor was designed with comfort in mind. A family-friendly bunk room, equipped with an XL twin-over-queen bed and a TV, shares a Jack-and-Jill bathroom that connects to a lovely guest bedroom with a king bed, TV, and balcony access. Completing this floor is a delightful guest bedroom with a king bed, TV, and access to the second-floor balcony featuring peaceful neighborhood views.Sandy Paws is the perfect coastal escape! With on-site parking, a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle, and 4 complimentary adult bikes, exploring is effortless. Stroll 10 minutes to the private boardwalk for beach access or park at the east pool for a quicker route. From there, cross 30A and use the gate code to enjoy the sugar-white sands. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 9):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin XL- over- Queen Bunkbed, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*This home is not pet-friendly.
